name: com.easygridmaker/grid-calculator
title: Easy Grid Maker — Drawing Grid & Aspect Ratio Calculator
description: Calculate drawing grid dimensions, square sizes, scale ratios, and distortion-free paper grids.

tools.name: calculate_drawing_grid
tools.description: Compute exact grid columns, rows, per-square pixel size, physical square size on drawing paper or canvas (cm, mm, or in), scaling ratio, usable drawing area, unused/crop margins, and even-row column suggestions.

imageWidthPx.description: Reference image width in pixels, e.g. 2400.

imageHeightPx.description: Reference image height in pixels, e.g. 1800.

surfaceWidth.description: Target drawing paper or canvas width in surfaceUnit, e.g. 29.7 (cm) or 11 (in).

surfaceHeight.description: Target drawing paper or canvas height in surfaceUnit, e.g. 21 (cm) or 14 (in).

surfaceUnit.description: Physical unit for surfaceWidth, surfaceHeight, and cellSize ('cm', 'mm', or 'in'). Defaults to 'cm'.

columns.description: Optional number of grid columns across the drawn width (1 to 100). Mutually exclusive with cellSize; defaults to 8 when neither is given.

cellSize.description: Optional desired physical side length of each square on the target surface in surfaceUnit (e.g. 2 for 2 cm squares). Mutually exclusive with columns.

fitMode.description: 'contain' fits the entire reference image inside the surface with unused margin; 'cover' fills the entire surface and reports image crop margin. Defaults to 'contain'.

tools.name: calculate_aspect_ratio_grid
tools.description: Evaluate standard paper or canvas sizes (A4, A3, A5, Letter, Legal, Tabloid, 8x10in, 9x12in, 11x14in, 16x20in, or custom) and return ranked distortion-free square-grid configurations with physical square sizes, margins, and aspect-ratio fit metrics.

paperSize.description: Standard paper or canvas preset ('A4', 'A3', 'A5', 'Letter', 'Legal', 'Tabloid', '8x10in', '9x12in', '11x14in', '16x20in') or 'custom'. Defaults to 'A4'.

orientation.description: Sheet orientation: 'portrait', 'landscape', or 'auto' (matches image orientation when imageWidthPx/imageHeightPx are provided, otherwise portrait).

customWidth.description: Custom paper/canvas width in unit. Required when paperSize is 'custom'.

customHeight.description: Custom paper/canvas height in unit. Required when paperSize is 'custom'.

unit.description: Physical unit ('cm', 'mm', or 'in') for output and custom/margin inputs. Defaults to 'cm' for ISO/custom sizes and 'in' for US presets.

margin.description: Optional uniform margin on each of the four sides in unit. Defaults to 1 cm (10 mm) for metric units or 0.5 in for inches.

imageWidthPx.description: Optional reference image width in pixels to match aspect ratio and compute fitted drawing area on the sheet.

imageHeightPx.description: Optional reference image height in pixels (provide together with imageWidthPx).

minColumns.description: Optional minimum column count to evaluate (2 to 50). Defaults to 4.

maxColumns.description: Optional maximum column count to evaluate (2 to 50, >= minColumns). Defaults to 16.
